task_title: Deployed-copy freshness enforcement for the ob1-distribute cron entrypoint
task_criteria: scripts/check-distribute-deploy.sh exists, is read-only, and when the deployed copy differs from the tracked canonical it exits 1 printing BOTH full paths, BOTH sha256 values and the remedy 'make deploy-distribute' (distinct loud messages for a missing deployed copy and for a non-executable one)

scripts/ob1-distribute.sh carries an in-script drift guard that exits 1 when the running copy is not byte-identical to the canonical, and the guard sits ABOVE the 'set -euo pipefail' line so the OB-DIST-001 harness (which slices from that line) is unaffected — scripts/tests/ob1-distribute-regression.sh still exits 0

make check-distribute-deploy exits 0 against the real pair (deployed ~/.hermes/scripts/ob1-distribute.sh byte-identical to scripts/ob1-distribute.sh) and scripts/tests/ob1-distribute-deploy-check-test.sh exits 0 covering the in-sync, drifted, missing and non-executable cases plus the guard's refuse arm

The Makefile carries a deploy-distribute target that copies the canonical script to the deployed path and gates its success report on the checker, and the header instructions in scripts/ob1-distribute.sh no longer tell the operator to hand-copy the file
